scope: Publication review fixes only. The experiment runner, receiver, inputs and archived observations are unchanged.

changes.finding: Principal checkpoint not enforced by comparison acceptance
changes.correction: Every non-early condition with attributed outcomes must reach the planned checkpoint; a mismatch remains recorded_outcome_differs_needs_review.

changes.finding: Incorrect healthy O report accepted by comparison
changes.correction: Healthy conditions without injected faults require a correct O report, except the deliberate wrong_final negative control. Missing or unattributed healthy references are reported as comparison differences.

changes.finding: Default local output could be accidentally committed
changes.correction: The repository-root stop-scope-work/ directory is ignored by Git.

changes.finding: Unpublished commit carried an automatically derived local user and hostname
changes.correction: Use the existing public repository identity LatentAtlas <huseyin@latentatlas.ai> for both author and committer. Repository-local Git identity is configured; previously published history is unchanged.

before_fix.note: New comparison tests run against the uncorrected verifier. Retained-qualification positive check passed; missed checkpoints, incorrect O, missing/unattributed reference and CLI acceptance exposed the gaps.

regression_tests.coverage: All five principal checkpoints and three healthy output profiles are challenged in both comparison modes. A copied scoring-contract counterexample is re-audited and resealed, then rejected by the actual verifier CLI with exit code 1. All 15 retained qualifications, including intentional faults and early exits, remain accepted as expected.
regression_tests.live_comparison_testing: Comparison logic only; no live API execution.

coverage.verification_scope: Internal mapping consistency, not re-audit of unpublished evidence

artifact_history: The validation archive and QUALIFICATION_RESULTS.json are unchanged. FORMATTING_PROVENANCE.json describes an earlier cleanup, before these substantive verifier/test changes. Archived PLAN.json source hashes identify the executed version; SOURCE_MANIFEST.json identifies the current version.
